slides.title: Fixing recovery with gadgets.
slides.body: Rollers, ice baths and powders help a little. None of them repays a short night.

slides.title: Your training pays the bill.
slides.body: Slower recovery, less power, and the same weights feel heavier.

slides.title: Same bedtime, every night.
slides.body: Pick a time that gives you 7 to 9 hours before the alarm. Weekends included.

slides.title: Dim the lights, park the phone.
slides.body: Thirty minutes of nothing bright before bed. Keep the room cool and dark.

slides.title: Early alarm? Earlier night.
slides.body: A 4:45 alarm means lights out by 9:30. Count back from the alarm.
